full_judgment:
Syed J. R. Mudassir Husain J:- In these 2 (two) appeals, the appellants are same the respondents are different but for a common question being involved as to whether the respondent of both the appeal are entitled to get scale of Tk.470-1135 and as such these two appeals are heard together and are disposed by this single judgment 

 11. In civil Appeal No.100 of 1998, the facts in short are that the respondent Nos. 2 and 3 Sultan Ahmed and Korshed Alam respectively are the employees under the appellants and they were promoted on 1-8-1978 from the rank of Laskor to the rank of tug Master and placed in the national pay scale of Tk. 220-420.They were given the new national pay scale of Tk. 325-610 as per government circular (Ministry of Finance) dated 1-1-1981, that as the respondent were plying B-Type vessel in 3 (three) shifts became entitled to the above scale of Tk. 470-1135 and the same was allowed by the deputy Director (Accounts) with arrears after examining their service record that subsequently the appellant No.1 Chief Engineer, Dredge Directorate by his order dated 9-12-1986 illegally cancelled the higher scale of pay of the respondent with a direction to give them the scale of Tk. 325- 610. Challenging the same, the respondent Nos.2 and 3 filed I.R.O. Case No.44 of 1987 in the 3rd Court, Dhaka under section 34 of the Industrial Relations Ordinance, 1969, that the. appellants contested the said I. R.O. Case stating inter alia that the respondent No.2 and 3 were promoted to the rank of Tug Master on 1-8-1978; they were transferred respectively to Tug Boat No.6 and M. L. Lila, that the said vessels do not fall within the category of B-Type vessel as per marine law. The Appellants further case was that respondent Nos.2 and 3 cannot get the pay scale of Tk.470-1135 without obtaining a second class mastership certificate as per the Finance Ministry's Circular dated 1-1-1981 and that they are third class certificate holders, that subsequently the respondents got second class mastership certificate in September/October, 1982 but they were not promoted as second class masters; that the appellants alleged that the said respondents with the help of interested persons managed to get entries (master B-Type vessel dated 1-8-1978) in their service book by different like with the motive of getting the pay scale Tk.470-1135. At the time of crossing of efficiency bar the Superintendent Engineer (the appellant No.2) came to know during the audit inspection that the respondent were being paid in the pay scale of Tk. 470-1135 illegally. The appellant then formed an Enquiry Committee and on the basis of the report of the Enquiry Committee the aforesaid illegal pay scale was cancelled and their pay was fixed at Tk. 325-610. As par approved set up of the Dredger Department there is no post of Master in B-Type vessel and as such the question of any appointment in B-Type Vessel did not arise. 

 14. It is further contended that the respondent Nos.2 and 3 managed the entries ( master B-Type vessel dated 1-8-1978) in their service books through different ink and hand with a ulterior motive to get the pay scale of Tk. 470-1135 and ultimately hey got the benefit with arrears through ones right of the appellants and when such false entries were detected upon an enquiry bad report the higher scale of pay of the respondents was cancelled by the competent authority but the High court Division wrongly held relying on a decision that the benefit once granted cannot be taken away Mr. B. Hossain, therefore, argued that there was no illegality in canceling the wrong entry in the service books followed by illegal benefit. The High court Division wrongly made the rule absolute in part relying on such questionable benefit. Hussain further argued that qualification and obtaining second class mastership certificate by the respondents do not entitle them to the benefit of pay sale of Tk. 470-1135 unless they are promoted and transferred to B-Type vessel and in such view of the matter the learned Judges of the High Court Division committed error of law in making the rule absolute in part with modification.
